findings.evidence: The Gotchas list covers summaries, disputed facts, confidentiality, 'revisit later', ultimatums and calendar titles, but nothing on secretly recording the conversation, a common move when users preserve evidence for Section 7
findings.fix: Add to Gotchas: "Never advise secretly recording the conversation. Consent laws differ by jurisdiction and a covert recording can breach policy and discredit the user in the formal process it was meant to support. Write a dated note of what was said right after instead."
